messages:
ellen_support: Hey team, customer reported a spike in client retries and 404s after upgrading their Node/TS SDK. They say routes that used to work now return 404 or unknown-route.
ellen_support: Customer says they upgraded from `@redwood/inference-js@0.20.4` -> `0.24.1` and started seeing errors in production an hour after deploy.
mira_support_lead: Oof. Any repro or sample request body?
ellen_support: Pasted the snippet they ran in prod (redacted keys):
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await c.chat.create({
  model: 'redwood-1.5',
  input: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Summarize sales deck' }]
});
```
ellen_support: This used to work with the older SDK where `input` was accepted. Now API returns 404 for `/v1/chat.create` or 400 complaining about unknown `input` in some customers.
jared_eng: That code shows they called `chat.create` client method which should map to `/v1/chat.create`. In v0.24 we renamed param `input` -> `messages` (to match server) but also changed route-level mapping for legacy clients. If someone has an old client calling new server or vice versa, mismatch can produce 404 + unknown-field errors.
jared_eng: Can you get me the exact HTTP requests from their logs (path + payload)?
ellen_support: Got logs, trimming keys: 
```
POST /v1/chat.create HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.dev
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"redwood-1.5","input":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize sales deck"}],"client_version":"0.20.4"}
```
mira_support_lead: Interesting: client_version is 0.20.4 in payload but they said they upgraded to 0.24.1 — could be a mixed deployment (some instances still running old package).
jared_eng: Yep. Mixed fleet would cause some requests to be routed to code paths that expect different param names. Also our routing layer will try compatible model variants; but if the control-plane sees an unexpected contract, it can 404 when the route signature isn't found.
ellen_support: The customer also reported increased billing due to retries — the client retries 429/5xx by default. They saw 3x tokens billed because calls retried and succeeded later.
jared_eng: For immediate mitigation: 1) Ask customer to pin SDK to the server-compatible version (or rollback). 2) Temp mitigation on server: accept `input` alias for `messages` for the next 24h while we roll out a compatibility gateway.
mira_support_lead: I created a quick repro in my laptop — I pulled `@redwood/inference@0.20.4` and `0.24.1` and toggled the payload. Repro steps:
1) Install `npm i @redwood/inference@0.20.4` and run snippet above -> returns 200 on old server snapshot.
2) Upgrade to `0.24.1` -> the SDK now sends `messages` and hits `/v1/chat.create` successfully.
3) Simulate mixed deploy: send `client_version: 0.20.4` but server expects `messages` -> server logs 404 route mismatch.

Command to reproduce locally:
```bash
# repro old client behavior
node -e "require('@redwood/inference') && console.log('ok')"
# curl to simulate older payload
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/chat.create -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-1.5","input":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' -v
```
jared_eng: Thanks Mira, filing an internal issue with eng-runtime. @deploy-bot can we schedule a quick gateway compat patch?
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy 3354324800 for compat-proxy alias-input-param (canary 10% -> 100% over 15m).
mira_support_lead: For the customer response: ask them to confirm all nodes upgraded or pin to `0.20.4` until we finish the gateway rollout. Also ask them to disable aggressive client-side retry during migration: set `retryPolicy: { maxRetries: 1 }` or similar.
ellen_support: I'll send the template reply with repro steps and the temporary mitigation.
jared_eng: Follow-up engineering action items: - eng-runtime to add `input` alias to chat.create deserializer for 24h - SDK team to publish warning in release notes and add version-check telemetry - support to advise customers on retry throttling and pinning.
mira_support_lead: Adding note to postmortem channel after deploy.
ellen_support: Customer notified, they will hold upgrade pending our patch. Closing loop once deploy is green. :thumbsup:
